Name: q_credit
SQL:
SELECT CREDIT_LIST.credit, CREDIT_LIST.tran
FROM CREDIT_LIST
GROUP BY CREDIT_LIST.credit, CREDIT_LIST.tran
ORDER BY CREDIT_LIST.tran;

Name: q_credit_receipt
SQL:
SELECT tb_kabala.rnum, orders.cn, Trim$([fname])+"  "+Trim$([pname]) AS namew, tb_kabala.wdate, orders.odate, orders.ordernum, tb_kabala.typ, tb_kabala.wnumber, tb_kabala.wname, tb_kabala.wsnif, tb_kabala.whashbon, tb_kabala.tpiraon AS TP, tb_kabala.nt, (DateAdd("m",Val(nz([nt]))-1,[tpiraon])) AS qdate, tb_kabala.total, tb_kabala.wnum, Null AS Expr1
FROM cust_list INNER JOIN (orders INNER JOIN tb_kabala ON orders.rnum = tb_kabala.rnum) ON cust_list.numw = orders.numw
WHERE (((orders.cn)=False) AND ((tb_kabala.typ)="אשראי"));
UNION ALL SELECT  Null AS Expr1, Null AS Expr2,null,items_sales.wdate, Null,"כללי" AS Expr3, items_sales.typ, items_sales.wnumber, items_sales.wname, items_sales.wsnif, items_sales.whashbon, items_sales.tpiraon AS TP, items_sales.nt, (DateAdd("m",Val(nz([nt]))-1,[tpiraon])) AS qdate,items_sales.total,  items_sales.wrnum, Val(nz([qtyp])) AS q
FROM items_sales
WHERE (((items_sales.typ)="אשראי") AND  ((Val(nz([qtyp])))>0))
ORDER BY TP;
